article.title: A Cheap Product Can Be Expensive to Switch Away From
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

paragraphs.en:
Price is one of the easiest ways to compare products, but it is not always the most important cost. A customer may see a cheaper alternative and still decide to stay with the current supplier because switching itself is expensive. Economists and business strategists call these switching costs. They can influence competition even when several alternatives exist.

Switching costs are not limited to cancellation fees. Consider business software. A new service may charge 20 percent less, but a company may need to migrate years of data, rebuild integrations, retrain employees, redesign workflows, pass security reviews, and negotiate a new contract. The subscription is cheaper, yet the total cost of changing suppliers can be much higher than the first-year saving.

Time is another cost. Employees who learn a new system are not spending that time on their normal work. Managers may also worry about operational disruption during migration. If a critical process fails for several days, the loss can exceed the software saving. This creates a gap between the sticker price of a competitor and the economic cost of adopting it.

Switching costs can also be psychological or organizational. Users become familiar with interfaces and habits. Teams develop informal knowledge about how to solve common problems. Procurement departments build relationships with suppliers. None of these factors appears directly on an invoice, but they can make change less attractive.

For an incumbent supplier, high switching costs can improve customer retention. However, they are not automatically a sign of a strong product. Customers may stay because leaving is painful rather than because they are satisfied. This distinction matters. A competitor that develops an easier migration tool, an industry standard that improves portability, or a regulatory change that lowers switching friction can suddenly weaken the incumbent's position.

For a challenger, simply offering a lower price may therefore be insufficient. It may need to reduce the customer's transition cost. Free data migration, compatibility tools, training, contract buyouts, and implementation support can be more persuasive than another small discount. The challenger is effectively competing on the cost of switching, not only on the cost of the product.

Managers evaluating suppliers should calculate total switching cost explicitly. What data must move? Which systems must be reconnected? How many employee hours are required? What is the risk of downtime? Are there contractual penalties? How long will both systems need to operate in parallel? These questions turn an abstract concern into an economic estimate.

Competition analysis should also distinguish between natural and artificial switching costs. Some costs are unavoidable because complex systems genuinely require migration work. Others may be created by restrictive data formats, difficult cancellation processes, or limited interoperability. The distinction can matter for customers, regulators, and investors.

A low price can attract attention, but a purchasing decision is about the full journey from the old solution to the new one. When switching costs are large, the cheapest product may not be the cheapest choice. Understanding that difference helps buyers negotiate better, challengers design stronger offers, and incumbents recognize whether loyalty comes from value or from friction.
paragraphs.zh: 比較產品不能只看售價，因為更換供應商本身可能非常昂貴。Switching cost 不只是解約金，也包括資料搬遷、系統整合、員工訓練、安全審查、流程重設與停機風險。高 switching cost 能提高 incumbent 的留存率，但客戶可能只是因為離開太痛苦，而不是真的滿意。一旦競爭者提供更容易的 migration、產業標準改善 portability，或政策降低 switching friction，既有優勢可能快速下降。Challenger 因此不只要降產品價格，也可以用免費搬遷、相容工具、training 與 implementation support 降低 transition cost。採購分析應明確估算完整 switching cost。
paragraphs.ja: 製品比較では価格だけでなく、supplierを変更するswitching costを見る必要があります。解約金だけでなく、data migration、integration再構築、employee training、security review、workflow変更、downtime riskなどが含まれます。高いswitching costはincumbentのretentionを高めますが、顧客が満足しているとは限りません。migration tool、portabilityを高めるstandard、規制変更などでfrictionが下がれば優位性は弱まります。challengerは値下げだけでなく、無料migration、compatibility、training、implementation supportによってtransition costを下げることができます。購買判断では完全なswitching costを明示的に計算することが重要です。

quiz.question: Why can a cheaper product cost more overall?
quiz.answer: Migration, training, integration, and disruption can exceed the price saving.
